messages.content: 哪一家網上書店有售《殺死一隻知更鳥》？

function.name: add_product_to_cart
function.description: This function allows users to add a product to their cart. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

quantity.description: The number of this product to add to the cart

cart_id.description: The ID of the cart, if no ID is given a new cart is created

message.content:
以下是幾家常見的網上書店，您可以在這些平台上搜尋並購買《殺死一隻知更鳥》（To Kill a Mockingbird）：

| 書店 | 網站 | 特點 |
|------|------|------|
| **Amazon** | https://www.amazon.com/ | 全球最大的電商平台，提供紙本、Kindle 電子書、以及二手書等多種格式。 |
| **Barnes & Noble (B&N)** | https://www.barnesandnoble.com/ | 美國大型連鎖書店，線上商城提供紙本、Nook 電子書及禮品卡。 |
| **Book Depository** | https://www.bookdepository.com/ | 提供全球免運費服務，適合國際訂購。 |
| **Books-A-Million** | https://www.booksamillion.com/ | 美國線上書店，經常有折扣與會員優惠。 |
| **Powell's Books** | https://www.powells.com/ | 知名獨立書店，線上商城涵蓋新書、二手書與稀有藏書。 |
| **Google Play Books / Apple Books** | https://play.google.com/store/books 或 https://books.apple.com/ | 可直接下載電子書版本，方便閱讀。 |
| **當地大型書店（如誠品、金石堂）** | 取決於所在城市 | 若您在台灣或香港，可透過本地大型書店網站查詢庫存與配送選項。 |

> **提示**：若您想確認特定語言版本（繁體中文、簡體中文、英文等），請在搜尋時加入「繁體版」或「簡體版」關鍵字；若您需要特殊裝訂（精裝、平裝、套裝等），也可在商品頁面中查看詳細規格。

祝您購物愉快！
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "Which online bookstore sells 'To Kill a Mockingbird'?" They want to know which online bookstores have it. We need to respond with a list of online bookstores that sell the book. We can provide a list of major online bookstores like Amazon, Barnes & Noble, Book Depository, etc. Also mention availability in different languages? But the question is generic. Provide a short answer. No function call needed.
